entries.9a986374da419e32: A single-segment business that manufactures and sells packaging containers and other products, conducted by the company and 7 consolidated subsidiaries (Kyoei Plasco Co., Ltd. and 6 overseas subsidiaries in China, the United States, the Netherlands, Thailand and India). The company collectively calls container bodies produced with molds it makes and owns, together with accessories such as caps and dispensers, 'standard bottles,' and by combining these and adding color or printing, offers packaging containers in designs tailored to each customer's requirements, with short lead times and in small lots. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥10,909 million in Japan, ¥2,200 million in China and ¥1,381 million in other regions.
